text:
erin (People Ops): Heads-up: updated perf cycle schedule posted. Self-assessments open now, due Mon Aug 12 23:59 PT. Calibration week Aug 13-17. Manager final submissions due Tue Aug 20. Guide + scoring kit: https://redwood.app/docs/perf-2026 (Manager tools section).

josh (Eng Manager): Thanks Erin. Quick Q: is the rubric changed or same as last quarter?

erin (People Ops): Rubric updated slightlyor clarity around ownership and impact. There's a short change log in the doc. Also a downloadable scoring CSV you should attach to the manager form.

priya (IC): Extensions? One of my reports is on short medical leave during calibration week.

erin (People Ops): Standard extension: up to 3 business days for short absences; for longer accommodations submit an exceptions ticket and HR will review. Use the extension form and cc your pplops partner.

pavel (SRE): Will hires under 30 days be rated this cycle? We had confusion last time.

erin (People Ops): Policy: new hires (<30 days) receive no formal rating. Managers should enter ramp notes in the "Onboarding & Ramp" field so Hiring/L&D can act.

srini (Director): I'll run two optional calibration office hours Aug 14 9am PT and Aug 16 4pm PT for tricky cases. Bring scoring sheet + 2 evidence links.

peopleops-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Self-assessments due in 7 days" to post to #people-ops and engineering channels.

josh (Eng Manager): One last ops ask: can we get a paste-ready invite body for calibrations? saves copying during crunch.

erin (People Ops): Yep  copy/paste below for invites: Subject: Calibration Team {NAME}
Agenda: 1) Context (5m) 2) Borderline cases (45m) 3) Finalize ratings & notes (20m)
Prep: scoring CSV, 2 evidence links, list of hires <90d

erin (People Ops): If you need an alternate calibration slot for timezone reasons, add availability to the doodle in the guide and tag @srini. DM me for any edge cases.
